summary: Turn an interesting paper into a falsifiable reproduction plan and a calibrated statement of what was learned.
outcomes: Separate reproduction from a new experimental claim
Design ablations that distinguish competing explanations
sequence: Extract claim, assumptions and evaluation protocol
Change one mechanism with a suitable control
Report uncertainty and failed reproduction attempts

visual.question: Would this ablation distinguish the proposed mechanism from an alternative?
visual.interaction: Select controls and expose remaining confounders

practice.task: Write a reproduction memo for a small open experiment
practice.success: Artifacts, deviations, uncertainty and unsupported claims are explicit
